criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Value register right on every frame. Several frames lean on defaults: 3 primitive wellhead and ladder, carrier bar and bridle don't read, left 55 percent empty; 7 flat white rings, stack overhang, blobs behind; 5 reads as a bar chart with a flat tag; 1 a flat silhouette with a pale crank; 9's worker low-poly under the cite; 4 flat bands. 6 and 8 strongest.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight deck, reliefs alternating with scenes, accent on figures, value steady, camera walk works. Crank motif unreadable, sky splits.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and was checked; core claims on the SEC exhibit, the 10-K and the RRC page; absences scoped to the release or neither filing; illustrations disclosed. The regulator claim rests on the Tribune with the dek attributing it. copy.json's caption was stale against caption.txt.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who are clear; where stops at the Permian and a leasehold share; the stake is not concrete; the meeting has no agenda link or comment route.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The hook is jargon for most of the feed; 2 pays; 3 turns; the middle sags with 6 cuttable; 8 lands; the close is soft.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register. Statistic headlines on 5 and 6; the caption opener is cryptic at feed speed.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject; the quarterly-filing absence structure, lastLight and the scene-relief alternation repeat recent decks.

one_sentence_fix: Cut slide 6 for a place and an action: Reeves County from c17 and the meeting's time and a comment route.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive wellhead and a ladder as the most legible object; bar, bridle and rod highlight don't read; empty left.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera about 1 m left and closer so the rod and bar run full height through the centre right with one rim; crop the ladder out.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat white rings, stack overhang, untextured stands, blobs behind.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bevelled tool-joint lips in dark worn steel, stacks centred on racks, background props deleted.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart of two flat rods; a flat tag.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Round profile with a specular streak; lit brass tag wired to the coupling.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Silhouette without rim; the pale crank is the brightest shape.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Narrow rim key behind the jack; crank exposure below the beam's.
Move the worker into the gate opening, backlit, lower its contrast.
